objective: Close every reproduced caller-to-meaning false-PASS path and reach at least 99/100 on this frozen internal architecture rubric without converting external unknowns into PASS.

mission_amendments.rule: A public or lexical factual assertion requires a host-signed Wikipedia, Wiktionary, Wikiquote or Wikidata retrieval receipt bound to the exact claim, quote, page and revision; a caller-declared checked flag never suffices.

A phenomenal measure exists only when every required frame, source, proxy, value and unit is complete. An incomplete first search requires exactly one RETRY over new resources. An incomplete second search returns VETO with GYROPHARE_TRACE_ABSENTE_APRES_DEUX_RECHERCHES, HALLUCINATION_BLOQUANTE_OU_PHENOMENE_INEXISTANT, and RETOUR_ENVOYEUR. A third search, a partial score or a compensatory average is forbidden.

mission_amendments.origin: latest explicit user rule during v17 build
mission_amendments.rule: The decision alphabet is exactly PASS, RETRY, VETO. Every traceable proposition must be measured. RETRY is temporary and requires an exact bounded recovery action. Exhaustion of the two-search budget, an unsigned claimed measurement, a contradiction, tampering, or an untraceable claimed phenomenon is VETO. Numeric placeholders are forbidden.
